# Rachel Lynde

## Overview

- **Gender:** Female  <sub>[v2 c26 P0](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0000), [v2 c26 P15](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0015)</sub>
- **Status:** Widow  <sub>[v2 c26 P0](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0000), [v2 c26 P3](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0003)</sub>
- **Origin:** Avonlea  <sub>[v2 c26 P15](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0015)</sub>

## Appearance

She is a stout, heavy-set woman who walks with a waddle. Her hands are work-hardened from a life of labor.

_Sources: [v1 c9 P19](../source/v01-c09.md#nw-v01-c09-p0019), [v1 c9 P31](../source/v01-c09.md#nw-v01-c09-p0031), [v2 c26 P1](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0001)_

## Personality

Rachel Lynde is an outspoken, sharp-tongued, and formidable woman who prides herself on speaking her mind without fear or favor. Highly opinionated and prone to meddling, she frequently gives unasked-for advice and delivers blunt home truths. Beneath her bossy exterior, however, she possesses a very kind heart, demonstrates tender devotion in times of illness, and actively helps the poor.

_Sources: [v1 c9 P30](../source/v01-c09.md#nw-v01-c09-p0030), [v2 c9 P0](../source/v02-c09.md#nw-v02-c09-p0000), [v2 c9 P3](../source/v02-c09.md#nw-v02-c09-p0003), [v2 c9 P10](../source/v02-c09.md#nw-v02-c09-p0010), [v2 c19 P22](../source/v02-c19.md#nw-v02-c19-p0022), [v2 c26 P0](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0000)_

## Goals

- To remain living in Avonlea among her lifelong friends  <sub>[v2 c26 P15](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0015), [v2 c26 P27](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0027)</sub>

## History

Mrs. Rachel Lynde lived in Avonlea as a long-time neighbor and close friend of Marilla Cuthbert. When Marilla took in the young orphan Anne Shirley, Rachel criticized Anne's freckles and red hair, provoking an explosive outburst of temper from the young girl; however, she later forgave Anne after receiving a dramatic apology. Throughout Anne's youth, Rachel remained a central pillar of community news and church fundraising. After her husband Thomas passed away quietly following a long illness, Rachel faced severe financial strain due to farm mortgages and medical costs, threatening to force her to leave Avonlea. To keep her friend in the community and allow Anne to attend college, Marilla invited Rachel to move into Green Gables. Rachel gratefully accepted, establishing a home in the north gable and taking over domestic care for Marilla and the Keith twins.

_Sources: [v1 c9 P16](../source/v01-c09.md#nw-v01-c09-p0016), [v2 c9 P0](../source/v02-c09.md#nw-v02-c09-p0000), [v2 c26 P0](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0000), [v2 c26 P3](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0003), [v2 c26 P15](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0015), [v2 c26 P17](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0017), [v2 c26 P21](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0021), [v2 c26 P23](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0023), [v2 c26 P26](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0026)_

## Background by volume

- Raised ten children and buried two  <sub>[v1 c9 P30](../source/v01-c09.md#nw-v01-c09-p0030)</sub>
- Lived as Marilla Cuthbert's neighbor in Avonlea for forty-five years  <sub>[v2 c26 P17](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0017)</sub>
- Mortgaged her farm eight years prior to help her youngest son move west  <sub>[v2 c26 P15](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0015)</sub>
